_: Onething's texts, one picked at random per send (src/lib/onething/core.ts). Indie-journal register: quiet, specific, no exclamation marks, no verdict on what the person wrote. {n} is the streak day. Every outbound text is one of these lines plus the site URL, and looksLikeOurs() matches against this file to keep our own echoes from being saved as thoughts — so add lines here, never inline in code.
